Q: Kotlin: Generate random number from 0 to 1 inclusive A:

Here is another idea to throw out for discussion. If you need 0f and 1f to be in your range but don't need every float in between to be a possibility, this could be a solution.

Let's say I just need an accuracy of thousandths (perhaps I'm measuring spark plug gaps--commonly measured in thousandths of an inch). So I want a random number [0..1] including both 0 and 1 plus the numbers in between: 0.001, 0.002, 0.003, etc. up to 0.998, 0.999, and of course 1.000.

Start by generating a random Int in the range from [0..1000]. Then convert it to a Float and divide by 1000f.

    val randInt = (0..1000).random()
    val randFloat = randInt.toFloat() / 1000f

And that's your solution. Using much larger top numbers will give a much greater granularity. This won't be satisfactory for every situation, but it does give a proper random distribution.

side note

I saw this algorithm (which was a flawed) in a deleted answer (almost certainly AI generated) to this question. I corrected the code and then remembered something from high school computer science class; we used this same algorithm in the opposite direction for generating random integers within an inclusive range. Perhaps that's were the AI found it and why its code was wonky.

Q: Word crashes after ThisDocument.Close when run from a MACROBUTTON field A:

I was able to reproduce the crash using your example code.
The version below doesn't seem to suffer from the same problem (don't ask me to explain why - something to do with OnTime calls maybe running in a different scope from the main code...)

Sub DocClose()
    ThisDocument.Activate 'OnTime only fires if ThisDocument is active at the scheduled time
    Application.OnTime Now, "CloseThisDoc"
End Sub

Sub CloseThisDoc()
    ThisDocument.Close
End Sub

Q: How can I remove all metadata from all files possible inside a folder and all its subfolders? A:

You would use:

exiftool -all:all= -r /path/to/files/

This command creates backup files. Add -overwrite_original to suppress the creation of backup files.

You don't want to use wildcards to try to limit file selection (see Common Mistake #2). For that you would use the -ext (extension) option.

Exiftool won't process any file that isn't on the writable file type list (see ExifTool FAQ #16), so files like AVI or MKV will be skipped.

You do not want to use this command on a RAW file type, such as NEF or CR2, as that will remove data that is required to render the image. See ExifTool FAQ #8.

Q: How to convert SQL containing JOINs, a subquery, GROUP BY and SUM() to CodeIgniter's active record A: 
$this->db->join('(SELECT my_promos.event_id, SUM(tickets_sold.quantity) AS my_sold_tickets,
                 (IFNULL(SUM(tickets_sold.price),0)*.10) AS earnings, IFNULL(SUM(tickets_sold.price),0) AS sales
                  FROM my_promos
                  JOIN tickets_sold ON tickets_sold.code = my_promos.link_code
                  WHERE my_promos.user_id = '532' AND DATE(my_promos.date) >= '2013-11-01'
                  AND DATE(my_promos.date) <= '2014-01-23'
                  GROUP BY my_promos.event_id) A','A.event_id = events.id', 'left');
